svg.text: Where each trap is caught in the pipeline, and what the system does instead of guessing. Case ids come from the synthetic starter kit.

folder name. No data crosses cases.

The file stays safe and is
Both sides cited with quote and
page. Review opens, no silent pick.

kept as a conflict for LEGAL.
A message is a claim. The field
A calendar entry is not evidence.
No evidence for a form field
Unknown stays blank with a reason.
Reason shown on the case queue.
with the rule that set it.
Every field cited to a source.
The mismatch is shown for a
rerun is logged on the ledger.
A key from another case is refused.
Every outcome above, including DENIED, QUARANTINED and FLAGGED, writes one hash-chained audit line in the same transaction as the change.
Verify chain recomputes every hash and reports the first broken seq. Entries hold ids, hashes and states, never document text.
